g.text: Supply: OWON at 12.0 V, OVP 12.6 V, 6 A current limit (the working max). F1 8 A fast 5x20. J4 is optional.

g.desc: Supply: OWON at 12.0 V, OVP 12.6 V, 6 A current limit (the working max). F1 8 A fast 5x20. J4 is optional.

g.text: Rev D 2026-09-30. 12V IN -> F1 -> M1 -> SW1 -> outputs. Every join is a WAGO 221 lever nut: W3/W4 on the input pair, W2 on the output +, W1 the ground bus.

g.desc: Rev D 2026-09-30. 12V IN -> F1 -> M1 -> SW1 -> outputs. Every join is a WAGO 221 lever nut: W3/W4 on the input pair, W2 on the output +, W1 the ground bus.

g.text: WAGO 221-415 five-port, ground bus: M1 LOAD- in; RISER-, CARD-, OUT- post, PROBE out

g.desc: WAGO 221-415 five-port, ground bus: M1 LOAD- in; RISER-, CARD-, OUT- post, PROBE out

g.text: M1: the shunt is internal between 2 (DC IN-) and 1 (LOAD-). Input negative goes to 2 via W4, never to W1 -

g.desc: M1: the shunt is internal between 2 (DC IN-) and 1 (LOAD-). Input negative goes to 2 via W4, never to W1 -

g.text: on the ground bus it bypasses the shunt and the meter reads 0 A.

g.desc: on the ground bus it bypasses the shunt and the meter reads 0 A.

g.text: SW1: A from M1.4, B to W2, yellow to ground (on the OUT - post terminal). Never swap B and yellow - dead short.

g.desc: SW1: A from M1.4, B to W2, yellow to ground (on the OUT - post terminal). Never swap B and yellow - dead short.
